| Specialization  | [Triggered Action](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/triggered-action)          |

| Earth           | [Skin Like Castle Walls](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.elementalist.level-1/skin-like-castle-walls)    |
| Fire            | [Explosive Assistance](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.elementalist.level-1/explosive-assistance)      |
| Green           | [Breath of Dawn Remembered](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.elementalist.level-1/breath-of-dawn-remembered) |
| Void            | [Subtle Relocation](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/feature.ability.elementalist.level-1/subtle-relocation)         |
